{{Top|leg}}
The '''Chronicle Room''' was one of the facilities of the [[Eanca Goa-Ato]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]' [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Hunters' Guild]] Hall on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. 

Rodian hunters wishing to verify their successful captures or [[Death/Legends|kills]] were required to record their achievements in the Chronicle Room, which was open to hunters at all [[Time/Legends|times]] and officials of the [[Atiang/Legends|Atiang]] were always present to hear testimonies. It could be entered by anyone with an account to report; guild members were allowed to watch.<Ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
